properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 20 at 7:47PM CDT until September 25 at 12:00AM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Illinois...

Rock River near Joslin affecting Whiteside, Rock Island and Henry
IL Counties.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Illinois...

Rock River at Moline affecting Rock Island and Henry IL Counties.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Rock River at Moline.

* WHEN...From Monday evening to late Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...At 13.2 feet, Water affects 60th Street south of John
Deere Road in Moline and 56th Ave from Green Valley Park 48th St.
Water is on Canal Road in Big Island. Smith's Island is affected by
flood waters.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 PM CDT Sunday the stage was 9.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
tomorrow evening to a crest of 13.2 feet Tuesday evening. It will
then fall below flood stage Thursday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

The next statement will be issued by Monday evening.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT FROM MONDAY EVENING TO LATE THURSDAY NIGHT
